---
title: "08 — Catalog and provenance certification"
format: html
---

## Goal

Certify that every reusable HCS environmental artifact is discoverable and traceable without opening the binary data file.

## Catalog outputs

- `catalog/products.csv` — provider/product/version identity;
- `catalog/variables.csv` — canonical variable definitions and dependencies;
- `catalog/files.csv` — artifact-level identity, extent, size, processing level;
- `catalog/coverage.csv` — spatial/temporal support and QC status;
- `catalog/checksums.csv` — immutable checksum registry.

## Certification checks

- no duplicate file identities;
- all heavy artifacts have checksums;
- all processed artifacts trace to raw inputs;
- all variables trace to a product or declared derivation;
- status and version are explicit;
- paths are relative to the external data root rather than machine-specific absolute paths.
